messages.text: Ines Petrova is waiting at the office: a word from the residents.
The drill struck water: a decision is waiting.
Supply drop delayed a month by dust over the landing zone. Earth sends its apologies.
Ines Petrova is waiting at the office: a word from the residents.
The aquifer on floor 2 is tapped: deep well pumps can draw on it. The showers are cautiously optimistic.
Supply drop is holding in orbit: the landing pad needs staff and power.
Ines Petrova is waiting at the office: room demand: a clinic.
Ines Petrova is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.
Supply drop landed: colonists 6, earth rations 30, oxygen 719, metal 25, brick 10, machinery 3, electronics 3, soil 15.

kept.message: The clinic is open. {name} is telling everyone you kept your word.

broken.message: Still no clinic. {name} is telling everyone you broke your word, and handing out bandages.

kept.message: {name} thanks you, for the residents, for fixing it ({what}).

broken.message: {name} says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it ({what}).
